assessment.pressure_signal: Both 6 rps rounds have a strictly smaller tail wait median and no larger peak native waiting depth than either 8 rps round. Only assess when all four windows are mutually thermally comparable and all requests pass the original evidence gates.
assessment.within_rate: Both same-rate pairs use the original D3 thermal, TTFT and last-terminal request/token throughput rules, with the earlier round as reference.
assessment.admission_capacity: Report the wait integral overlapping at least four native first-scheduled to native last-output envelopes. These timestamp envelopes approximate occupancy.
